'''''Cotoneaster integrifolius''''', the '''entire-leaved cotoneaster''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007|accessdate=2014-10-17}}</ref> is a species of ''[[Cotoneaster]]'' that is a low growing shrub. It has been grown as an [[ornamental plant]] in gardens and public rock gardens. It has been introduced to Ireland, but has become naturalised. It produces a red berry-like [[pome]] fruit that are an important food source for birds that disperse the seeds in their droppings. They are sometimes grown as a [[Hedge (barrier)|hedge]] for home security{{Citation needed|reason=Is that really true of this short-growing species?|date=July 2009}}.
